Company at a glance

Established 2016–17. Incorporated 2020.

Bhagavat Powertech Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified, startup-driven organization specializing in power and renewable energy solutions. Established in 2016–17 as Bhagavat Enterprises, it was incorporated as Bhagavat Powertech Pvt. Ltd. on 16 June 2020, and operates as a service-oriented company delivering reliable, future-ready energy and infrastructure solutions. It is a recognized Startup India enterprise, per its profile. The company was promoted by Mr. Jatin Das, an alumnus of the Indian Air Force.

2020Incorporated as Pvt. Ltd. (16 June)

Vision

To create lasting value through innovative, reliable and intelligently designed renewable energy solutions: high-quality solar and EV infrastructure with uncompromised safety, timely execution and cost-effective performance, becoming a trusted force in the transition to a cleaner, smarter, more sustainable energy future.

Mission

To drive adoption of renewable and sustainable energy by delivering value, advanced technology and service excellence, empowering communities, businesses and individuals with clean, affordable and efficient energy systems at the highest standards of quality, safety and environmental responsibility.

PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana

Rooftop solar with central financial assistance.

A Government of India (MNRE) scheme for residential rooftop solar. Eligibility, as published: an Indian household that owns a roof suitable for solar, has a valid electricity connection, and has not availed another solar subsidy.

₹30,000/kW
up to 2 kW
₹18,000
for the additional kW (up to 3 kW)
Max ₹78,000
for systems of 3 kW and above

Journey: register on the national portal → feasibility approval → choose a registered vendor → installation → inspection and commissioning → subsidy claim. We can help you through the steps.

Per its company profile, Bhagavat Powertech has facilitated subsidy disbursement for 150+ customers across renewable energy projects.

Subsidy depends on system size, eligibility and approval; it is not guaranteed and does not make a project free. Commercial and industrial connections are not covered. States may add their own support. Confirm current terms at pmsuryaghar.gov.in.
